xmldoc.short_description: Display words with sizes proportional to weights.

description.p: wordcloud creates a word cloud chart whose font sizes are based on numeric weights or category counts and returns a wordcloud graphics object.
wordcloud(tbl, wordvar, sizevar) uses the table variable wordvar as word labels and sizevar as numeric weights.
The returned object stores the displayed words in WordData and their weights in SizeData.
The wordcloud properties page lists the supported object properties.

Supported properties are MaxDisplayWords, Color, HighlightColor, Shape, LayoutNum, SizePower, FontName, TitleFontName, Box, Title, OuterPosition, InnerPosition, Position, Units, and PositionConstraint.

example_item.example_item_description: Display weighted terms from a table.
